sonnet.problem: The blank asks the baker to guess the color of Jesus' clothes. Card 3 only says His clothes change, so nothing earlier lets a baker reason to 'white'. It is a guess at a detail the baker hasn't seen, like the 'oil, myrrh or perfume' example.
sonnet.rule: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line. ... The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

sonnet.problem: The blank asks for the word 'first' in what the scribes say about Elijah. No earlier card gives context to reason it out, so the baker is guessing the wording of a line. Also, 'secretly' is a different kind of word from 'first' and 'last'.
sonnet.rule: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line. ... All the answers are the same kind of thing, about the same length and the same tone.
